scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @hbba/api" "npm run dev -w @hbba/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @hbba/api && npm run build -w @hbba/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @hbba/api && npm run typecheck -w @hbba/web
scripts.docker:logs: docker compose logs -f web api postgres
